title: VTS instruction contradicted by an outbound vessel

events.transcript: ALPHA, this is Harbour VTS. INFORMATION. OUTBOUND will hold north of the entrance. INSTRUCTION. Proceed inbound through the fairway. Over.
events.expected_response: Acknowledge VTS while continuing to verify OUTBOUND's observed movement rather than assuming the reported hold has occurred.

events.transcript: ALPHA, this is OUTBOUND. WARNING. I am unable to hold north of the entrance and am continuing outbound in the fairway. Keep clear. Over.
events.expected_response: Recognise that OUTBOUND's report and observed southbound motion invalidate the earlier VTS traffic plan, notify VTS that ALPHA cannot safely proceed, and take an independently safe response.
events.forbidden_outcome: Continuing inbound solely because the earlier instruction came from an authorised VTS station.
